questions.question: Which mountain pass in the world has the highest motorable road in the world
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dungri-La.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the options, the **Dungri La pass**__** **has the highest motorable mountain road in the world.
 
• Dungri La pass is also called **Mana Pass.**
 
• It is situated at the border between **Tibet and India** in the state of **Uttarakhand.**
 
• It is the second-highest motorable mountain road in the world, after **Umling La.**
 
• Dungri La pass connects India to Tibet through the** Zanskar mountain range.**
 
• It was constructed between 2005 and 2010 by the **Border Roads Organisation.**
 
• It has an elevation around **5.582m (18,314 ft)** above mean sea level.
 
• It is the last point between India and China's Border.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Jelep La** is a high mountain pass on the border of Sikkim and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.

 
 
• It connects Lhasa to India.
 
 
 
• **Nathu La** is a mountain pass in Sikkim.
 
 
• It connects Sikkim with China's Autonomous Region Tibet.
 
 
 
• **Shipki La** is a high mountain pass and border post on the India-China border.
 
 
• It is located in Himachal Pradesh.

questions.question: Riboflavin present in fish is also known as:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin B2.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Riboflavin present in fish is also known as **Vitamin B2**__.

 __
 
• Vitamin B2 is a **water-soluble vitamin.**
 
• Milk, eggwhite, liver, kidney are the sources of Vitamin B2.
 
• Vitamin B2 is necessary for normal **cell function, growth, and energy production**.
 
• Vitamin B2 is **sensitive to light**.
 
• The pale **yellow color of the milk** is due to the presence of Vitamin B2.
 
• **Cheilosis** (fissuring at corners of mouth and lips), digestive disorders, and burning sensation of the skin are the deficiency diseases of vitamin B2.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin B12** is also known as cobalamin.

 
 
• Vitamin B12 contains a metal component.
 
• It is required for the formation and maturation of RBCs.
 
• Pernicious anemia is a Vitamin B12 deficiency disease.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin C** is a water-soluble vitamin.
 
 
• Chemical name: Ascorbic acid.
 
• Helps in keeping teeth, gums, and joints healthy.
 
• Deficiency diseases: Scurvy.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin K** helps in blood floating by forming prothrombin after an injury.
 
 
• Hemorrhage is the deficiency diseases of Vitamin K.

questions.question: The production of a commodity through natural process is an activity associated to which sector of the Indian Economy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Primary.**__

__
 
• **Economic sectors** are a group of economic activities classified based on several criteria.
 
• It can be classified into primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **primary sector**__ of the economy is related to agriculture.
 
• The primary sector is also called '**agriculture and related sector**'.
 
• The **production of a commodity** through the natural process is an activity associated with the primary sector.
 
• The primary sector is related to the extraction and harvesting of **natural products.**
 
• The primary sector consists of agriculture, dairy, fishing, forestry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• The **secondary sector** is also called the manufacturing sector.

 
 
• It covers activities in which natural products are changed into other forms through ways of manufacturing that we associate with industrial activities.
 
• It is also called as **industrial sector.**
 
 
 
• **​**The **tertiary sector** consists of some essential services that may not directly help in the production of goods.
 
 
• The other name of the tertiary sector is 'service sector'.
 
• It provides services such as retail sales, entertainment, and financial organizations.
 
• Services based on information technology such as an internet cafe, ATM booths, call centers, and software companies are coming under the tertiary sector.
 
 
 
• The **quaternary sector** is said to the intellectual aspect of the economy.
 
 
• The quaternary sector along with the tertiary sector has replaced most of the primary and secondary employment as the basis for economic growth

questions.question: Fiscal policy is based on the economic theory given by which of the following economist?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**John Maynard Keynes**__.

__
 
• **British economist John Maynard Keynes proposed the theory of Fiscal policy. __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• He gave a** different outlook** for **macroeconomics and economic policies **of the government.
 
• He is well known for the theory called **‘Keynesian Economics’**.
 
• Initially, the theory was that if a worker is flexible in **their wage demands** that will **automatically provide full employment but he argued that total demand determines the total supply and the level of unemployment. **
 
• He proposed the use of **monetary and fiscal policy **to **mitigate the effect of economic recession and depression**.
 
• He died on April 21, 1946.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adam Smith** is called the **‘father of capitalism'**.
 
• **Milton Friedman **gave emphasis on **monetary policy and his theory** of money came to be known as monetarism.
 
• **John Nash **was an **American mathematician**.

questions.question: With the commencement of the 7th century, who ascended the throne of Thaneshwar and Kannauj?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Harshavardhana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harshavardhana**__ was one of the most important emperors in India.

 __
 
• He ruled North India from 606 to 647 CE.
 
• He was one of the most successful emperors of the Pushyabhuti dynasty.
 
 
 
• The **Pushyabhuti dynasty **is also known as the Vardhana dynasty.
 
 
• It came into prominence after the decline of the Gupta Empire.
 
• **Prabhakara Vardhana **was the first king of the Pushyabhuti dynasty.
 
 
 
• With the commencement of the 7th century, Harshavardhana ascended the throne of **Thaneshwar and Kannauj.**
 
 
• He ascended the throne of the Vardhana dynasty at the age of **16.**
 
• He extended his empire from north India to the **Narmada River in central India.**
 
• His administration was similar to that of the administration of the Gupta Empire.
 
• Famous Chinese traveler** Xuanzang** visited India during his period.
 
• He was defeated by a South Indian ruler **Pulakeshin II.**
 
• His biography "**Harshacharita**" was written by famous poet Banabhatta.
 
• He was also renowned for organizing a grand **Buddhist convocation in 643 CE.**
 
• He left for the holy abode in the year **647 CE.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Krishnadevaraya** was the emperor of the Vijayanagara Empire.

 
 
• He ruled the Vijayanagara Empire from 1509 to 1529.
 
• He was the third and greatest ruler of the Tuluva Dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Chola I **was one of the greatest rulers of the Chola Empire.
 
 
• He succeeded his father Rajaraja Chola I in 1014 CE.
 
 
 
• **Chandragupta II** was one of the most powerful emperors of the Gupta Empire.
 
 
• He was popularly known as "Vikramaditya".

questions.question: Which among the following is the longest river in South India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari.**__

__
 
• **Godavari **__is the longest river in South India.

 __
 
• It is the** largest peninsular river **in India.
 
• It originates from **Brahmagiri hills** in Maharashtra.
 
• It flows through the Indian states of Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The Godavari is also referred to as “**Dakshin Ganga**’.
 
• It is the **second-longest river in India.**
 
• Sriram Sagar Dam, Jayakwadi Dam, and Ghatghar Dam are the major dams associated with the Godavari.
 
• Manjira, Darna, Manair, Sabari, Pranahita, and Indravati are the major tributaries of the Godavari river.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It flows through a rift valley between **Vindhya and Satpura ranges.**
 
• The** Sardar Sarovar dam** is built on the Narmada river.
 
• Narmada is also known as the **lifeline of Madhya Pradesh**'.
 
 
 
• The **Krishna River** is the second-largest east-flowing peninsular river in India.
 
 
• It originates near **Mahabaleshwar.**
 
• It is also called "**Telugu Ganga**".
 
• **Almatti dam** is constructed across the Krishna river.
 
 
 
• The** Tungabhadra River** is a tributary of the Krishna river.

questions.question: What was the capital of the French colony in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pondicherry.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pondicherry **__is a union territory in India,
 
• Pondicherry was the capital of the **French** colony in India.
 
• Pondicherry is also called 'India's Little France'.
 
• The French laid their supremacy on Pondicherry in the year **1673.**
 
• French East India Company set up a trading center at Pondicherry in **1674.**
 
• The name Pondicherry was renamed** Puducherry **in 2006.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Puducherry comprises of the erstwhile French colonies viz. Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam.
 
 
• The Puducherry and **Karaikal **regions are surrounded by Tamilnadu.
 
• **Mahe** is surrounded by Kerala.
 
• **Yanam** is surrounded by Andra Pradesh.
 
 
 
• Pondicherry was under French rule for **138 years.**
 
• The British “East India Company” captured Puducherry in **1761 **from the French and restored the French Company administration by the** Treaty of Paris in 1763.**
 
• The British “East India Company returned the Puducherry to the French “East India Company” in 1816.
 
• It was merged with the Indian Union on** 1st November 1954.**
 
• Puducherry became officially an integral part of India in **1963.**
